summary: Commerce Bancshares filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Steven A. Brandjord as Corporate Controller and Chief Accounting Officer effective May 15, 2026, and the results of its April 24, 2026 Annual Meeting. Director elections and ratification of KPMG as auditor were approved, with a quorum of 125.9M shares represented. This is a routine current report covering standard governance matters, not a special situation. No extraordinary event such as activism, strategic review, delisting, or restructuring is indicated. The filing is purely administrative in nature.
